title: UI: Test Runs workspace tab - run list, run detail with stages and timings, live log viewer, history, cancel/rerun, input identity
outcome:
HOW (children: tm-ncc6.7.1 tab wiring, .7.2 list+detail, .7.3 log viewer)
- Follow the Work tab exactly: kind "testRuns" in ui/src/workspace-types.ts, factory in ui/src/workspace-tabs.ts (createWorkTab at 161), validation in ui/src/workspace-tab-validation.ts (28, 88), label in ui/src/panels/pane-tab-labels.ts (87), dock action in ui/src/panels/ControlPanelSurface.tsx (93 'Open Work'), open action in ui/src/app-workspace-actions.ts (41/801) and the one-tab-per-pane singleton in ui/src/workspace.ts (openWorkInWorkspaceState ~940-988).
- New small modules under ui/src/panels/: test-runs-api.ts (GET/POST wrappers with preserveGatewayErrorBody like work-visualizer-api.ts), use-test-runs.ts (list state fed by the 'testRunChanged' live delta, no polling), TestRunsPanel.tsx (list + filters), TestRunDetail.tsx (stages table, first-failure diagnostics, run dir + fingerprint copy, cancel with confirm, rerun), TestRunLog.tsx (SSE follow client modeled on ui/src/api-terminal.ts:80, bounded buffer, follow/wrap/jump), test-runs.css.
- Layout, states and copy per the prototype linked on the epic; theme tokens (--signal-*), phone width, keyboard focus.

DEPENDS ON: tm-ncc6.6. BLOCKS: tm-ncc6.8, .9 UI parts.

REVIEW FIXES (F2, F13): the API client module pattern is ui/src/work-visualizer-api.ts (not panels/); a disk-`running` stage inside a canceled/unknown record is rendered as 'interrupted'; theme/phone-width checks are a manual checklist plus a string test that test-runs.css defines both light and dark token sets.
acceptance:
- The tab opens from the dock action, persists/validates like the Work tab (workspace tests extended for kind testRuns).
- List shows state pill, preset, requester, short fingerprint, started, duration, drift/unknown flags; filter by state; deltas update without polling (no second read after the initial load).
- Detail shows every stage with state/exit/duration, 'unrun' and 'interrupted' explicitly, first-failure diagnostics, run dir and fingerprint; cancel asks for confirmation; a 409 on rerun is rendered.
- Log viewer follows a running stage over SSE, stops when the stream ends, offers wrap and jump-to-end, buffer bounded (long-stream test).
- tsc clean; vitest green; test-runs.css defines light and dark tokens (string test); manual checklist: 400 px width, both themes.
